ValidationRule.description: Users must use the checkpoint process
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > DATE(2022,05,04) && ISCHANGED(Status) && NOT(ispickval( Reason , 'Clarification')) && NOT(ispickval( Reason , 'Support Coordination')) && NOT(ispickval( Type , 'Record Deletion')) && NOT(ispickval( Type , 'Reports and Dashboards')) && NOT(ispickval( Type , 'User Management')) && NOT(ispickval( Type , 'Marketing Cloud')) && OR( (ispickval(Status, 'Closed') && OR(isblank( Acknowledge_Date__c ), isblank( Ready_for_Testing__c ), isblank( Solution_Provided__c ))), (ispickval(Status, 'Solution Delivered') && OR(isblank( Acknowledge_Date__c ), isblank( Ready_for_Testing__c ), isblank( Solution_Provided__c ))), (ispickval(Status, 'Ready to Test') && OR(isblank( Acknowledge_Date__c ), isblank( Ready_for_Testing__c ))), (ispickval(Status, 'Assigned - In Progress') && isblank( Acknowledge_Date__c )) ) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $Permission.Operations_Access) && (Automation_Closed__c = false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please use the checkpoint feature to advance the status of the case.
